name: plugin-emerald-member-context
description: Twilio Flex plugin that renders the Emerald Fitness member context and live call intelligence handed over by the voice AI agent.

scripts.deploy: twilio flex:plugins:deploy --major --changelog "Emerald Fitness member context panel" --description "Renders the voice AI handoff context on the agent desktop"
scripts.release: twilio flex:plugins:release --name "Emerald Fitness member context" --description "Enable the Emerald Fitness member context panel" --plugin plugin-emerald-member-context@1.1.0
